CustomField.description: True when this segment is NOT the first segment of its quote (first = earliest Start Date among segments that have one; SortOrder then Id break ties). Maintained by QuoteSegmentFlagService from flows on Quote Line Group. False means first segment or not evaluated, so unevaluated records keep counting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked on Year 2+ segments of a ramp. The first segment (Year 1, or the amended segment on an amendment) stays unchecked.
CustomField.label: Is Later Segment
